pr_title: Fix settings not being loaded at CLI
pr_body:
Closes #25898
The problem was that the default settings weren't being loaded, so 
https://github.com/go-gitea/gitea/blob/ad69f7175af3dc6974df6ad22f22833c284456df/models/user/user.go#L593
was always false.
pr_comments: I wonder if this is really the right place to load the settings or if we should do it earlier. Doing it in the middle of command processing does seem odd.
Both way works as of my tests. I thought to initialize together with the DB but thinking better at the beginning may be more clean. I'll adjust it

Ah I see the context now, previous place was fine then I guess, the validation does not depend on settings it looks like. Note I'm not really knowledgeable around these parts so take my comments with a grain of salt :)

As we're loading settings there's happening some output when a user runs `gitea admin user create`. Like this:
```
2023/08/11 10:34:13 ...les/setting/cache.go:75:loadCacheFrom() [I] Cache Service Enabled
2023/08/11 10:34:13 ...les/setting/cache.go:90:loadCacheFrom() [I] Last Commit Cache Service Enabled
2023/08/11 10:34:13 ...s/setting/session.go:74:loadSessionFrom() [I] Session Service Enabled
New user 'user1' has been successfully created!
```
That reinforces that it needs to be after validation.
Hmm so its ok? I think its unavoidable unless we try to change the config for logging outputs before
Just revert to previous location imho.

Oh no no! It happen doesn't matter where loadsetting is. There's log statements inside loadsettings. I think its alright as it states settings are being loaded but if you dont want log to happen I can see what I can do. I know I caused some confusion because it looked like I was saying because of position. Pls dont avoid my PRs :laughing:

This fix works but it is somewhat hacky and fragile.

Ideally, there should be command line options to set the flags, but not continue loading more unclear settings.

There is already `overwrite.AllowCreateOrganization`, the same to `Visibility`

Made some changes in 170261a6a3ef2719e27ca6b8c7297cf5db85cf0b :

* do not show unnecessary logs
* add comments

issue_context.title: Create org permissions of user created via cli client
issue_context.body:
### Description

With (default) settings as

```
[admin]
DISABLE_REGULAR_ORG_CREATION = false

[service]
DEFAULT_ALLOW_CREATE_ORGANIZATION = true
```

a user created via `gitea admin user create` does not have "create org" permissions. If it is intentional that the CLI client does not respect the relevant settings, it might be helpful to add an option to the CLI client.

### Gitea Version

1.19.0

### Can you reproduce the bug on the Gitea demo site?

No

### Log Gist

https://gist.github.com/nbenn/f4cf2314da1cc32d8d5325b9a0e9cbe3

### Screenshots

_No response_

### Git Version

_No response_

### Operating System

_No response_

### How are you running Gitea?

Docker: gitea/gitea:1.19.0

### Database

SQLite
comments:
> Maybe caused by #25330

No, it's not related IMO.

Before  #25330, `func Init(opts *Options) {` also only called `loadCommonSettingsFrom`, the settings were never fully loaded.


After #25330, the `loadCommonSettingsFrom` is also called, so it's not related.
I can see what happened. The `loadCommonSettingsFrom` will be loaded but `loadServiceFrom` will not be included. And `DEFAULT_ALLOW_CREATE_ORGANIZATION = true` hasn't been loaded.

review_comments: It's better to move this line to line 86 and have some tests in `admin_user_create_test.go`.
~This is not right, because then some settings will be loaded twice.~
